result.summary: The intersection features multi-story residential buildings and sidewalks but lacks basic pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals. The roadway is wide with poor pavement quality and no visible lane markings, which may lead to unpredictable vehicle behavior.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: Despite being a signalized intersection, there are no painted crosswalks to guide pedestrians or alert drivers to crossing locations.

hazards.name: Degraded Road Surface
hazards.description: The pavement is heavily cracked and patched, creating potential trip hazards and uneven surfaces for all road users.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated walk/don't-walk signals are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle traffic lights which may not provide sufficient crossing time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style painted crosswalks at all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to improve crossing safety and predictability.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to reduce crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility to turning drivers.

result.summary: The image shows an urban intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, a traffic signal, and a marked crosswalk. However, the crosswalk markings are faded, and the presence of parked cars near the corner may limit visibility between drivers and pedestrians.
